source_snapshot.procedure: Upgrade or downgrade BMC when the system is powered on.
source_snapshot.criteria: Firmware flashes through supported protocols and BMC resets exactly once.
source_snapshot.script: Private system power-control and Redfish firmware-check repositories. Fifteen minutes attended and fifteen machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes chassis power on/status after flash with credentials in arguments, but does not prove flash completion, POST/OS/device readiness, storage safety or reset history.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes state change but supplies only a secret-unsafe command and status bit.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds completed-flash gate, single transition, readiness, device/storage and recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.history: V003 multi-GPU thermal and related passive display cases are excluded.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Post-flash power control needs explicit approval, real readiness signals, bounded timeout and no extra reset or retry.

original_test_intent: Power on the approved SUT after the separate BMC firmware operation, prove a single clean chassis transition and BMC/POST/OS recovery, and collect health evidence for the flash result.
original_method: Verify completed flash and standby state, preserve baseline, issue the documented power-on once under approval, monitor chassis/BMC/console/POST/OS and compare firmware, device, storage and health with baseline.
manual_activity: The owner confirms flash completion and approves power-on; an operator supervises console/POST/boot and recovery while automation collects protected power and health evidence.
safety_requirements: Do not power on during active flash/reset/storage operation
Use protected credentials and one documented command
Do not add reset or AC cycle
Monitor BMC, console, POST, OS, thermal/power and devices
Stop on timeout, device/storage error or unexpected reset
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, completed flash and standby state
Compare firmware, devices, storage, logs and health without recovery autonomy or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable to the power transition, but unsafe credential handling and grepped chassis status cannot prove completed flash, boot, devices, storage or reset count.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented protected power interface once after the flash handoff, then wait on real BMC/POST/OS and device/storage health signals.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System-power-on BMC flash context, single-reset criterion, scripts and 15/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a flash-complete-baseline-poweron-readiness-health sequence with one transition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds flash-state gate, secret safety, real boot readiness and health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A chassis power bit alone cannot establish successful post-flash recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incomplete BMC image or boot failure may only become visible when power-on begins.

project_override_considerations: The project may use IPMI, Redfish or validated PDU power-on, but must preserve one approved transition, completed-flash evidence, bounded readiness and no extra reset/AC action.
expected_evidence: Approval, target, completed flash/task/version and standby state
Redacted power command and chassis transition timing
Recovery record if invoked and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The V004 row consistently defines powered-on BMC flash/post-flash context. V003 sensor history is a different identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Flash handoff, state, power method and readiness rules are finite inputs; after supply, one controlled power-on is feasible.

review_improvement: Expands DeepSeek's command into a completed-flash-gated one-time transition with real boot, device, storage and reset evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correct power bit does not prove the flash or host recovered. The separate task record and health oracle are normal prerequisites, making this an attended conditional operation rather than fully executable or permanently blocked.
